name: Bulltongue
desc: Bulltongue (Sagittaria lancifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 44 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sagittaria lancifolia, the bulltongue arrowhead, is a New World perennial, monocot plant in the family Alismataceae, genus Sagittaria, with herbaceous growth patterns.
